Reports

Coherent compliance reporting — choose the right export for your audience

Scheduling & digests — Billing

Each report serves a distinct purpose — executive posture, operational management, audit preparedness, portfolio intelligence, or evidentiary archive.

How reports work together

Monthly Digest surfaces trends · Evidence Readiness identifies remediation · Requirements Report tracks obligations · Compliance Summary explains posture · Audit Evidence Pack preserves evidence.

External review: Audit Evidence Pack
Executive briefing: Compliance Summary Report
Day-to-day obligations: Requirements Report
Remediation prep: Evidence Readiness Report
Monthly oversight: Monthly Operations Intelligence Digest
Structured data: CSV exports where available
Audit Evidence Packs

Past monthly portfolio briefings sent to your email. View summary or download the digest PDF.

No digests yet. Enable Monthly Operations Intelligence Digest in Notification Preferences to receive them.

Regulatory/System Exports

Regulatory/System Exports require the regulatory export entitlement. Audit Evidence Pack remains available via Reports when PDF reports are enabled.

Export trust and scope

Server-generated PDFs are authoritative for external sharing. CSV exports are point-in-time operational data. Evidence Readiness history preserves immutable snapshots — re-download returns the same file. Audit Evidence Pack is the governed evidentiary archive; other reports support monitoring and management.
